notes: Leaf opens with the upper half of the page blank; ॥ ओं ॥ is set alone on its own line. Running head ॥ अथर्ववेदे २ । १. २ ॥ with printed page number १४ in the outer margin.
structural_marker: ॥ ओं ॥ printed centred above this line, opening the kāṇḍa; sūkta-opening numeral ॥ १ ॥ in the left margin
text_devanagari: वे॒नस्तत्प॑श्यत्पर॒मं गुहा॒ यद्यत्र॒ विश्वं॒ भव॒त्येक॑रूपम् । इ॒दं पृश्निर॑दुह॒ज्जाय॑मानाः स्व॒र्विदो॑ अ॒भ्य॑नूषत॒ व्राः ॥ १ ॥
प्र तद्वो॑चेद॒मृत॑स्य वि॒द्वान्ग॑न्ध॒र्वो धाम॑ पर॒मं गुहा॒ यत् । त्रीणि॑ पदानि॒ निहि॑ता॒ गुहा॑स्य॒ यस्तानि॒ वेद॒ स पितु॒ष्पि॒तास॑त् ॥ २ ॥

notes: Final सर्वा carries no accent mark on the page.
text_devanagari: स नः॑ पि॒ता ज॑नि॒ता स उ॒त बन्धु॒र्धामा॑नि वेद॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ । यो दे॒वानां॑ नाम॒ध एक॑ ए॒व तं सं॑प्र॒श्नं भुव॑ना यन्ति॒ सर्वा ॥ ३ ॥

notes: The pluta numeral ३ carries three marks on the page: a vertical stroke above (read as svarita U+0951), a short vertical stroke immediately below it, and a horizontal line below that (read as anudātta U+0952). The identity of the short vertical stroke below the ३ could not be determined from the image and is recorded here rather than guessed; it is not represented in text_devanagari.
text_devanagari: परि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी स॒द्य आ॑य॒मुपा॑तिष्ठे प्रथम॒जामृ॒तस्य॑ । वाच॑मिव व॒क्तारि॑ भुवने॒ष्ठा धा॒स्युरे॒ष न॒न्वे॒३॒॑ षो अ॒ग्निः ॥ ४ ॥
परि॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑नान्यायमृ॒तस्य॒ तन्तुं॒ वित॑तं दृ॒शे कम् । यत्र॑ दे॒वा अ॒मृत॑मानशा॒नाः स॑मा॒ने योना॒वध्यैर॑यन्त ॥ ५ ॥

notes: A thin vertical rule is printed between अस्तु and दि॒वि. It is materially unlike this edition's daṇḍa (compare the daṇḍa closing the preceding line, which is short, thick and runs headline-to-baseline): this stroke is hairline-thin and runs from above the headline to below the baseline. Read as an inked rule/space, i.e. a defect of the impression, not as a character, and therefore not represented in text_devanagari. दिव्य carries no accent mark.
structural_marker: sūkta-opening numeral ॥ २ ॥ in the left margin
text_devanagari: दि॒व्यो ग॑न्ध॒र्वो भुव॑नस्य॒ यस्पति॒रेक॑ ए॒व न॑म॒स्यो वि॒क्ष्वीड्यः॑ । तं॒ त्वा॑ यौमि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा दिव्य देव॒ नम॑स्ते अस्तु दि॒वि ते॑ स॒धस्थ॑म् ॥ १ ॥

notes: The akṣara between मृ॒डा and न्ध॒र्वो could not be resolved at the resolution of this scan (4000 px wide). It is a single-akṣara-width conjunct carrying a svarita; direct comparison on the same page with the ग of गन्ध॒र्वो (line 13) and of गुहा॒ (line 3) shows it is NOT that ग. Left as [?] rather than completed from a parallel.
text_devanagari: दि॒वि स्पृ॒ष्टो य॑ज॒तः सूर्य॑त्वगवया॒ता हर॑सो॒ दैव्य॑स्य । मृ॒डा[?]॑न्ध॒र्वो भुव॑नस्य॒ यस्पति॒रेक॑ ए॒व न॑म॒स्यः॑ सु॒शेवाः॑ ॥ २ ॥

notes: भिः in अ॒न॒व॒द्या॒भिः॒॑ carries BOTH a vertical stroke above and a horizontal line below on the same akṣara; both are transcribed as printed (॒ then ॑ per canonical combining order). आभिर and आ of आ च carry no mark.
text_devanagari: अ॒न॒व॒द्या॒भिः॒॑ समु॑ जग्म आभिरप्स॒रास्वपि॑ गन्ध॒र्व आ॑सीत् । स॒मु॒द्र आ॑सां॒ सद॑नं म आहु॒र्येत॑ः स॒द्य आ च॒ परा॑ च॒ यन्ति॑ ॥ ३ ॥
